unverified_issue_candidates.quote: when the gaze cue stimulus offsets before the target onsets this may therefore function as a cue that reallocates attention shifted to the gazed-at-location (i.e., via the gaze cue stimulus) back to the central ﬁxation
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 该句主语是'offsets'（第三人称单数），但后面出现了'onsets'，从语义和语法看应是第三人称原形。源文确实如此，未静默修改。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: the cue-target stimulus onset asynchrony, referred to as the SOA
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 该短语出现在第5页，但第4页末尾有同一概念，存在跨页术语衔接问题，非逻辑错误，仅标记。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: Given limitations in the amount of visual information that a person can simultaneously process through to conscious perception, selective visual attention is necessary.
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 第1页末尾出现'people tend to respond faster to peripheral targets that are cued rather than miscued by speciﬁc visual stimuli (Posner, 1980; Posner et al., 1980; Posner & Petersen, 1990)。'，第2页开头为'Given limitations...'，跨页衔接处可能有页眉/免责声明插入，但语义连贯，不视为错误。仅标记。

self_check: 已核对：总体效应量grm=0.26（95% CI [0.22, 0.29]）、423效应量/137样本/4239参与者、各调节变量F值和t值、公式1和2的结构、r=.92的插补值、异质性百分比（90.25%）、SOA分类定义和对应效应量。不确定的点：第5页'601 to 80 ms'疑似应为'601 to 800 ms'但照录原文；表2中厌恶表情ES=3,k=2的效应值grm=0.49但置信区间[-2.15, 3.13]不包含零，与p=.256的显著性判断一致，已保留。摘要中'All reported moderator analyses were planned and preregistered'与正文一致。讨论中提及的未纳入元分析的IOE研究（Frischen & Tipper, 2004; Frischen, Smilek, et al., 2007）原文用'although note'说明。所有统计数值均核自正文提取文本，未添加或推断未见于文本的数据。
